title: Rav Yirmeyah bar Acha
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He reports Rav in Chullin 51b and disputes Rav Chisda there. Hyman calls this a textual error and proposes the reading cited in Dikdukei Soferim and found by the Rosh: Rav Sheshet reported R' Yirmeyah bar Abba, who reported Rav; Rav Chisda disputes Rav Sheshet.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: The heading has bar Acha. Hyman proposes a different chain: Rav Sheshet→R’ Yirmeyah bar Abba→Rav, with Rav Chisda disagreeing with Rav Sheshet. The William Davidson vocalized text of Chullin 51b instead has Rav Yirmeyah bar Acha→Rav, then Rav Chisda. It supports the cited current reading, not Hyman’s alternate chain.

Hyman attributes the alternate chain to דק״ס (conventionally Dikdukei Soferim) and the reading before the Rosh (הרא״ש). The supplied דב in two places is read contextually as רב; the same unit spells Rav Sheshet fully at its end. The letters remain unchanged in the Hebrew.
The alternate chain’s א״ר title is rendered R' rather than Rabbi or Rav. Hyman’s fully written Rav titles elsewhere are retained; the two patronymics are not harmonized.
